description.value: Bella Gelateria is an internationally award-winning artisan gelato shop that has crafted small-batch, 100% natural-ingredient gelato in Vancouver since 2010, earning the top Gelato World Tour ranking and repeated Georgia Straight Best Gelato recognition. The shop uses traditional Italian methods with Italian-imported Effi machines and local partners including Avalon Dairy and Vancouver Island Sea Salt. With five Metro Vancouver locations and extensive dietary-restriction options, it is a well-established sweet-stop destination for touring cyclists passing through the city.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 42m; stands (4 spaces) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m; stands (4 spaces) at 79m; stands (6 spaces) at 94m. Total: 20 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active with detailed product, awards, and location pages confirming Bella Gelateria is a thriving multi-location artisan gelato brand; the 2026 copyright and 2023 awards entries confirm current operation. Vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options are explicitly confirmed on the menu page, corroborating OSM's diet:vegan=yes. No bike infrastructure (racks, parking), washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving those fields null; takeout is positively evidenced by the in-store menu language and the website's listed Delivery and online Shop services.
concerns: OSM record lacks a specific street address (addr:street and addr:housenumber not set); the website lists five distinct Metro Vancouver locations (1301 Robson St, 1752 Davie St, 4700 Kingsway St Burnaby, 4567 Lougheed Hwy Burnaby, 625 Howe St) and it is unclear which specific location this OSM node represents.

Front page contains anomalous text ('pay n play casino sites' and a generic 'Welcome to our website. We are dedicated to providing quality content and services.') suggesting possible spam injection or a CMS placeholder error; all product, location, and awards subpages appear legitimate.
No phone number is present in either OSM or the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, internationally award-winning artisan gelato destination with multiple Vancouver locations, confirmed vegan and GF options, and active operations — a worthwhile sweet stop for touring cyclists.
